title: Rustic Stone Venue
description: Wood-slice centerpieces, sage linen, and rattan chargers against an interior stone wall. Wildflowers in clear bottles keep each table low and open so guests can see across them. The rest of the venue is worked the same way — a circular moon-gate arch with sheer draping over the sweetheart table, a guest book and card station under blush foil balloons, dessert set along the stone ledge, and paper florals fixed to the old fireplace grate.
